thread:
olivia: heads up — main CI is red, ~12 integration tests failing. seeing repeated 503s from mock-flagd (/v1/flags) in the test job logs. any recent changes to the mock?
chen: looking. can you paste the failing snippet?
olivia: 
```
2026-03-17T15:02:11Z ERROR http_client - GET http://mock-flagd.test.svc/v1/flags?keys=user_enabled 503 Service Unavailable
stack: client.go:142 -> flag_store.go:87
```
sam: that's the flagd mock we run as a k8s Deployment in ci-namespace — infra-bot should have restarted it if oom/restart happened. infra-bot: flagd-test-03 restarted (exit code 137) at 15:00 UTC — health checks failing for ~90s.
jess_qa: still failing the same tests when I reran the job locally — flake looks deterministic when flagd responds 503. can we fallback tests to the in-memory flag emulator? quick patch to env FLAGD_ENDPOINT=emulator:// would dodge the external call.
olivia: good idea. i can open a quick PR to set the emulator for the flaky suite. would prefer to triage root cause too — maybe saturation on the mock under concurrency.
chen: showing spikes in CPU and FD usage on the mock pod around 14:59: CPU ~95%, file descriptors exhausted. container logs show repeated `accept` errors. suspect connection leak from the new streaming client change in pr#482.
sam: marking this as blocker for the run. can someone bisect? if the change in pr#482 touched the streaming client in flag lib, that matches.
jess_qa: i'll queue a narrow bisect: run failing test against main minus pr#482 and then with it. also adding FLAGD_TIMEOUT=200ms to CI to fail faster.
olivia: opening quick PR now: set FLAGD_ENDPOINT=emulator:// for the flaky suite and FLAGD_TIMEOUT=200ms. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5137 (draft)
chen: nice. infra-bot: can you bump replicas for flagd in ci-namespace to 3 temporarily?
infra-bot: scaling deployment/flagd-test to 3 replicas — success.
sam: after scale up, i'm seeing fewer 503s in the live job; still want the PR to avoid noise while we bisect.
jess_qa: running bisect jobs now, will report which commit introduced the spike. ETA ~20m. @olivia please hold off merging until we confirm. :thumbsup:
olivia: will hold. thanks team.
chen: follow-up action: if bisect confirms pr#482, revert or patch streaming client to close connections properly. i'll add a postmortem note to the incident doc.
jess_qa: bisect done — regression introduced by pr#482, streaming client forgot to close resp.Body on error path. creating PR to fix.
sam: great — after fix merged, scale back flagd replicas to 1 and revert emulator override.
olivia: merge incoming for the test patch and the client fix. CI green on rerun. closing thread. :tada:
